purpose: Phase 10 held-out targets: never scanned or audited before. Used for the out-of-sample applicability metric (M2-heldout) and a separate recall row. See benchmarks/phase10-preregistration.md.
ground_truth_source: The CVE each target's vulhub environment documents (github.com/vulhub/vulhub, master, <vulhub_env>/docker-compose.yml uses this image tag).

targets.note: The vulhub env pairs this with php-fpm; the benchmark scans nginx alone.

pre_registered_risks: postgres: nmap -sV often reports only a version range for PostgreSQL, which yields no exact CPE; a miss or no correlation is possible.
php: the PHP version may only appear via the HTTP server banner/X-Powered-By; nmap may emit only an Apache httpd CPE.
Port membership in nmap's top-1000 (80, 5432) is checked before the first scan without -sV, as in Phase 9.
